SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NELP SELECTS ORGANIZATIONS FOR RE-GRANTING BASED ON KNOWLEDGE OF AND RESEARCH INTO THE ORGANIZATION'S PAST WORK, REPUTATION, AND CAPACITY TO MEET THE CURRENT PROJECT NEEDS. THE ORGANIZATION'S BUDGETS ARE REQUIRED BEFORE PAYMENT AND REPORTS MUST BE SUBMITTED AFTER THE PROJECT IS COMPLETED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE NELP FINANCE TEAM WORKS WITH THE AUDITOR TO PREPARE THE 990 AND REVIEWS THE RETURN ONCE IT IS COMPLETE. THE 990 IS SHARED WITH THE FULL BOARD FOR REVIEW BEFORE IT IS OFFICIALLY SUBMITTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BOARD MEMBERS AND KEY STAFF ARE ASKED TO DISCLOSE ANY POSSIBLE CONFLICTS ANNUALLY. IF ANY BOARD MEMBER SHOULD HAVE A CONFLICT, THE BOARD MEMBER SHALL RECUSE THEMSELVES FROM ANY DELIBERATIONS AND DECISIONS IN THE TRANSACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD'S FINANCE COMMITTEE PERIODICALLY REVIEWS SALARIES OF EXECUTIVE DIRECTORS AND KEY EMPLOYEES IN COMPARABLE NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATIONS AND ALIGNS SALARIES FOR NELP'S PRESIDENT/CEO AND KEY EMPLOYEES WITH ITS FINDINGS FROM THOSE REVIEWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST AT THE ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICES DURING REGULAR BUSINESS HOURS.
